description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoreferrer' which extends another class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform'. It implements a method to add the rel="noreferrer" attribute to links targeting other windows, enhancing security against phishing attacks.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoreferrer
classes.description: A class that adds rel="noreferrer" to link elements targeting other windows to improve security.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Modifies the attributes of a link element to ensure rel="noreferrer" is present if target is set to open in a new window.
